stepBody: What is the probability of winning a Teddy bear and a Sticker in two spins?##figure2.gif##

figureAlts.figure2.gif: A description and table related to a wheel-spinning game at a carnival, showing the true distribution of prizes. The table has two columns: Prize and Chance (%). Row 1: Nothing, 90%; Row 2: Teddy bear, 1%; Row 3: Pinwheel, 3%; Row 4: Sticker, 6%. The text instructs to use this distribution to answer probability questions.
